newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin makes short move to rural residence.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin makes short move to rural residence.

text.p: President Boris Yeltsin left the Barvikha sanatorium outside Moscow on Wednesday for an official government residence nearby, a Kremlin spokesman told Reuters.

Yeltsin, 65, who is convalescing after undergoing heart bypass surgery on November 5, had been at Barvikha since November 22. He moved to the Gorky-9 residence several kilometres (miles) away at 6:15 p.m. (1515 GMT).
Earlier, the spokesman said Yeltsin had gone to a residence within the Barvikha compound.
Doctors have said that, Yeltsin, who is already working several hours a day, should be back at his Kremlin desk this month.
Medical staff say he is recovering well from the quintuple bypass operation to relieve clogged cardiac arteries.
